Tea was EXTREMELY helpful in taking care of my mom’s two dogs (Cavalier King Spaniel and Pomeranian) on short notice after the Cavalier was injured at Washington Dulles airport before his flight to LA. She and the staff here at ACE nursed him back to health so he could enjoy the rest of his visit here in SoCal. Tea even took the time to forward all important documents to the dogs home vet back in the DC area. I highly recommend her and Ace!!
Staff was helpful and kind. Services are reasonably priced, but may try to push additional services. Overall, a positive experience.

Do not recommend. Stay FAR AWAY from this place.

I chose this clinic for a simple, standalone 3-year rabies vaccine for my senior dog because they advertised a "low-cost rabies shot." When I called, they quoted $10 for the shot and $35 for an exam fee. At $45 total, it seemed reasonable. It turned out to be an entirely slimy, unprofessional experience driven by aggressive upselling and hidden fees.

After waiting 20 minutes in the exam room, a technician asked standard questions and immediately tried to upsell additional vaccines. When I declined, explaining my dog has a regular vet for annual care, the technician stated the doctor would examine my dog "in the back." In 40 years of dog ownership, I have never had a vet perform a routine exam away from me. Before I could object, the technician grabbed the leash and dragged my confused dog across the slippery floor into a back room.

Another 20 minutes later, the vet entered without my dog. He didn't introduce himself. When questioned about separating pets from owners, he dismissively claimed it was standard practice. He then repeatedly tried to upsell me on more vaccines, specifically pushing a Leptospirosis vaccine. Even after I declined a second time, he kept pitching.

After the vet left, a different technician entered with a bill for over $67. When I challenged the price against the $45 quote, she casually said, "Let me see if we're still running that special." She adjusted it down, but the new total was still over $53 due to a hidden $7 "biohazard disposal fee" that was never disclosed upfront. To make matters worse, they hadn't even administered the shot yet - they held my dog in the back as leverage until I authorized the final amount. At the front desk, I was hit with an additional 3% credit card fee.

What vet worth their salt separates a senior pet from their owner for a routine exam, uses high-pressure sales tactics, and nickel-and-dimes clients with surprise fees? This place reeks of desperation. Stay far, far away.

The best animal hospital I have taken my fur babies, doctor and all their staff are super friendly and caring. Doctor DJ it’s the best. Thank you. Fully recommend ace animal hospital.

In a word about this vet practice — grateful. I brought my 10 year old dog here, drove over one hour from LA, because they had in house imaging and came recommended by a friend. She had serious gastrointestinal issues and had not eaten in days. Dr Vardi and the technician spent 30 min or more just reviewing all the records from all the vets I had already seen. He was patient and knowledgeable and thorough. We left without a conclusive diagnosis but we had a solid plan to get her back on track. It was a complex set of meds and I had lots of questions. I think I called or texted every single day for 5-6 days. The staff was amazingly effective every single time. The women Diana and Tee who answer the phone are knowledgeable, responsive, and caring. Dr DJ ended up taking over my case when Vardi was away, and he also spent considerable time with me on the phone talking through options and next steps. A couple weeks in, my girl is thriving. This vet is a gem. I hope I won’t need them again soon but I’m sooo glad to know they are there. Many thanks, Ace AH. 🙌🏼🐾
